0022600203.text: The Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, on a four-game winning streak) host the Lakers (9-2, first in the Pacific and first in the West, on a five-game winning streak). Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Los Angeles is missing Quentin Grimes (finger) and Austin Reaves is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Hawks' last meeting a 141-116 loss in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
